senses.definition: vb. split, divide (NH chiefly in secondary meanings and deriv.; Arabic فَلَجَ divide, split; Aramaic פְּלֵיג, ܦܠܰܓ divide; Ethiopic ፈለግ ravine, stream; Assyrian palgu, canal);—
Pf. 3 fs. נִפְלְגָה Gn 10:25; 1 Ch 1:19 was divided (earth).
Pf. 3 ms. פִּלַּג Jb 38:25 cleave a channel for rain.
Imv. ms. פַּלַּג (Ges§ 52 n) ψ 55:10 divide their speech (their counsels).
